actual_objects.title: A quarrel staged for others
actual_objects.odia:
ଅଙ୍ଗୁଳି ସନ୍ଧିରେ ମଳି
ଭିତରେ ଭିତରେ ସଲା ସୁତୁରାଲୋ
ଉପରେ ଉପରେ କଳି ।
actual_objects.literal_meaning: Dirt between the fingers; agreement behind the scenes, quarrelling on the surface.
actual_objects.explanation: Two sides appear to fight while privately cooperating. The repeated contrast between inside and outside exposes a performance meant to mislead an audience. The saying accuses the quarrel of being staged; it does not merely describe people who disagree but remain friendly.
actual_objects.meaning_odia: ବାହାରେ ଝଗଡ଼ାର ଦୃଶ୍ୟ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଭିତରେ ଦୁଇ ପକ୍ଷର ବୁଝାମଣା ରହିଛି। ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ଭୁଲ୍ ବୁଝାଇବା ପାଇଁ ବିରୋଧର ଅଭିନୟ କରାଗଲେ ଏହି କଥା ଖାପ ଖାଏ। ସତରେ ମତଭେଦ ହେଉଥିବା ସାଙ୍ଗମାନଙ୍କୁ ମାତ୍ର ଦେଖି ଏପରି ଗୋପନ ବୁଝାମଣା ଧରିନେବା ଠିକ୍ ନୁହେଁ।
actual_objects.usage_example: Two organisers loudly blame each other in public, although they have already agreed privately to divide the benefit. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
actual_objects.cultural_context: The three source lines are retained. The address particle ଲୋ adds a conversational voice; the English rendering conveys the contrast without inventing a named listener.

actual_objects.odia: ଡାହାଣୀ ହୋଇ ଲାଗିବା; ଗୁଣିଆ ହେଇ ଝାଡିବା
actual_objects.title: Creating trouble, claiming the cure
actual_objects.category: dictionary-labelled proverbial saying; editorial close reading
actual_objects.literal_meaning: To afflict as a witch, then drive it out as the healer.
actual_objects.explanation: Two roles face one another in a short, balanced line: the one associated with the affliction and the one who removes it. The headword explains possession in the language of a historical belief. Our close reading treats the paired roles as an image of someone creating trouble and then claiming credit for relief. The change of role, rather than a documented supernatural event, supplies the sting. A modern example can expose a manufactured problem without making accusations of witchcraft against any person.
actual_objects.meaning_odia: ଛୋଟ କଥାଟିରେ ଦୁଇ ଭୂମିକା ମୁହାଁମୁହିଁ—ଲାଗିବା ଭୂମିକା ଓ ଝାଡ଼ିବା ଭୂମିକା। ଅଭିଧାନର ଶବ୍ଦାର୍ଥରେ ଅପଦେବତା ଆବିର୍ଭାବର ପୁରୁଣା ବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଏହି ଯୋଡ଼ି ଭୂମିକା ନିଜେ ଅସୁବିଧା ତିଆରି କରି ପୁଣି ତାହା ଦୂର କରିବାର ଶ୍ରେୟ ନେବାର ଚିତ୍ର ହୁଏ। ଭୂମିକା ବଦଳରେ କଥାର ଦଂଶନ ଅଛି; ଏହା କୌଣସି ଅଲୌକିକ ଘଟଣାର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ। ଆଜିର ଉଦାହରଣରେ କୃତ୍ରିମ ସମସ୍ୟାକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରିହୁଏ, କାହାକୁ ଡାହାଣୀ ବୋଲି ଅଭିଯୋଗ ନକରି।
actual_objects.english_summary: Our reading sees the same person creating a problem and claiming credit for its remedy.
actual_objects.odia_summary: ନିଜେ ସମସ୍ୟା କରି ତାହାର ସମାଧାନର ଶ୍ରେୟ ନେବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଆସେ।
actual_objects.usage_example: Original imagined example: An organizer deliberately removes a useful instruction from a form, then presents restoring it as his special solution to everyone’s confusion. A colleague quotes the paired-role line while explaining what changed. The example criticizes the documented alteration, not anyone’s supposed supernatural powers.
actual_objects.cultural_context: The supernatural vocabulary is historical source language, not an endorsed explanation of illness. The dictionary supplies the headword definition and saying, not an explicit figurative-use gloss; the manufactured-problem reading is editorial. No identified healer, ritual, community practice or origin is established.

actual_objects.title: The director behind the action
actual_objects.category: dictionary-labelled Dhaga headword idiom; source-informed editorial reading
actual_objects.literal_meaning: Gobardhan Das, the master of the play.
actual_objects.explanation: The dictionary defines a concealed controller: others visibly act, while this person directs them. The theatrical wording identifies the person behind the action, not a documented theatre practitioner. Our application asks who actually makes a decision when somebody else announces it; hidden direction need not be guessed from appearances alone.
actual_objects.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଏହା ଏମିତି ଜଣେ ସୂତ୍ରଧରଙ୍କୁ ବୁଝାଏ, ଯିଏ ନିଜେ ଚିହ୍ନା ନପଡ଼ି ଅନ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କ କାମକୁ ଚଳାନ୍ତି। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ହେଉଛି—ଖବର ଦେଉଥିବା ଲୋକ ଓ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନେଉଥିବା ଲୋକ କିଏ? କେବଳ ଚେହେରା ଦେଖି ଲୁଚା ସୂତ୍ରଧର ଥିବାର ଅନୁମାନ କରିବା ଠିକ୍ ନୁହେଁ।
actual_objects.english_summary: A named theatrical idiom points to concealed direction behind visible action.
actual_objects.odia_summary: ଆଗରେ କାମ କରୁଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କ ପଛରେ ଥିବା ସୂତ୍ରଧରକୁ ଏହି ପଦଟି ବୁଝାଏ।
actual_objects.usage_example: Original imagined example: ମୀନା ସଭାରେ ନୂଆ ସମୟ ଘୋଷଣା କଲେ। ରବି ପଚାରିଲେ, “ଏହି ସମୟ କିଏ ଠିକ୍ କଲା?” ମୀନା ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତିର ଚିଠି ଦେଖାଇଲେ। / Meena announced a new meeting time. Ravi asked who had chosen it, and she showed him the decision letter. This invented scene explores responsibility; it does not establish a secret plot.
actual_objects.cultural_context: The source labels the whole headword Dhaga and supplies its figurative meaning. Gobardhan Das remains part of the expression; this page does not identify a historical individual, author or origin. Bengali and Hindi equivalents are listed, not evidence of transmission direction.
